gloss: written record of oral account; dictation; oral history transcript

definitions.gloss: written record of oral account; dictation transcript
definitions.explanation: A document created by writing down what someone has said, especially oral histories, interviews, or spoken testimony. Common as a literary and journalistic genre in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{聞|き}き{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled oral accounts of war experiences.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{聞|き}き{書|が}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: This book is based on oral accounts from craftsmen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{聞|き}き{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I recorded local history by taking oral accounts from elderly people about life in the past.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) and ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write), in their conjunctive forms. The literal sense is "listening and writing" — recording what one hears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take oral accounts)
- {聞|き}き{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧ (to compile oral accounts)
- {聞|き}き{書|が}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧ (to be based on oral accounts)

{聞|き}き{書|が}き is an established literary genre in Japan, used for documenting the words of craftsmen, historical witnesses, and elderly community members. The term emphasizes faithfully recording spoken words rather than the writer's interpretation.
